scope: Full4834-frame Dev, not Test. All registered rows and failures retained. Cached replay speed excludes pixel/encoder preparation and is not end-to-end FPS.
note: A few retained old identities can be recovered, but long-gap same-identity weak observations rarely retain reliable body-point transport. No new-IR advantage exceeding measurement precision; global low-score threshold reduction damages HOTA. All rows, removals and both detector frontends preserved.
